vlmkit / UI verificationNode.js 24+v0.28.0

VLM-assisted UI.
Verified in the browser.

vlmkit connects an AI agent's VLM vision to real-browser measurements, so it can implement UI from screenshots, find breakage, fix it, and prove the result.

Install one skill. The AI picks and runs the right UI workflow.

APM / RECOMMENDED apm install mizchi/vlmkit
SKILLS CLI / NPX npx skills add mizchi/vlmkit

Need APM first? curl -sSL https://aka.ms/apm-unix | sh

CASE 01 / VLM IMPLEMENTATION

A small model rebuilt the page from pixels alone.

Haiku used its vision with vlmkit's deterministic signals. Four rounds produced all copy, all six regions, the five-color palette, and 0.97–0.99 component IoU.

Read the full run ↗

CASE 02 / ADOPTION FEEDBACK

It found defects the existing VRT suite missed.

At 375px, integrity found 13px of page overflow. During the fix it caught a new button protruding 29px past its parent—with the selector and exact delta. Four captured states moved from DEFECTS to CLEAN.

page-overflow-x · 375px · +13pxbutton:nth-of-type(5) · +29px

CASE 03 / MIGRATION

A visual migration reached zero drift.

An agent migrated Tailwind markup to vanilla CSS using only VRT feedback, reaching 0.0% pixel diff across 7 viewports in 3 rounds.

Read the migration report ↗

02 / PLAYABLE PROOF

NEW IN 0.11 The interaction gates stopped reading markup and started performing the gesture.

Some defects only exist
while you are dragging.

A pixel diff cannot see a drag that never starts, a card that lands in the wrong pile, or a win banner that never appears. So the site publishes a real game, and proves it the way behavior has to be proved: by playing it.

  • 52/52two seeds played to a win in CI
  • 144plies, with the DOM audited after each one
  • 57tests: the rules headless, the view in Chromium
  • 7interaction families the probes drive

Red on any of these blocks the deploy

vlmkit check integrity vlmkit check a11y focus vlmkit check a11y touch --level AAA

Playing this page by hand found three defects no gate reported. Each is a rule now: drag-selects-textdblclick-selects-textdrag-ghost-illegible

Play the demo → Read what 0.11 changed ↗ Six more sites, and how each was judged → Eighteen features, one defect each →

03 / THE LOOP

Turn visual opinions
into fixable facts.

A kickback returns the broken location and measurements. Fix it, run again, and keep going until green.

  1. 01

    MEASURE

    Measure in a real browser

    Capture DOM geometry, rendered pixels, computed styles, and accessibility states under identical conditions.

  2. 02

    KICK BACK

    Return the exact location

    Go beyond “failed” with the viewport, selector, diff size, and a concrete direction for the fix.

  3. 03

    PROVE

    Prove it again

    People and agents rerun the same gates and share a single exit-code contract for done.

04 / ROUTE THE TASK

Route the task
with one command.

No reference image? Tracking change? Defining release conditions? The entry point stays short and the result stays machine-readable.

NO REFERENCE / 3 VIEWPORTS

$

05 / PRINCIPLE

Vision proposes.
Measurements decide.

An agent saying “done” does not make the page correct. vlmkit turns visual claims into reproducible measurements.

“The loop is the product.”

Measure → fix → prove it again
◎

Deterministic

The same input gets the same verdict—geometry and pixels, not a VLM's opinion.

↯

Actionable

Kickback includes the viewport and selector, connecting each failure to the next edit.

⇄

Shared by people and agents

CLI, Playwright, MCP, or CI: every entry point follows the same exit-code contract.

WITH A KEY / TYPESAFE JEV

The model says what and where.
The page gives the values.

Four tools ask TypeSafe Jev typed questions—a box, a yes/no, a choice—and never ask it to name a measurement.

Feature Jev answers vlmkit measures Measured
Classify each diff regiondiff png --jev Jev answersA choice per region: text, colour, position or presence vlmkit measuresThe regions themselves, from the pixel diff MeasuredText 14/14, colour 18/18, presence 17/17; 1–6px shifts 11/16, every miss marked unsure
Find an element from a descriptioninspect locate Jev answersIs it shown (yes/no), then a box, then a box again on a magnified crop vlmkit measuresThe crop, cut from the original pixels; the point, in click coordinates Measured94% of targets hit; 0 of 85 decoys accepted
Check statements about a screeninspect claims Jev answersOne yes/no per statement, all in one request vlmkit measuresNothing: it advises and never gates Measured54 of 55 planted problems caught; 0 false alarms on 43 clean pages
Is an animation visibly broken?inspect motion --jev Jev answersPer frame: is each target shown, its box, and a yes/no per forbidden statement vlmkit measuresFrames on the held clock; jumps, snap-backs and easing fitted from the boxes; with --selector, geometry from the page Measured7/7 broken caught, 7/7 intact passed; about $0.002 a page

Jev is opt-in: --jev turns it on where a command also works without it, and inspect motion with --selector alone still caught 6 of the 7. Asked to name an easing, Jev was at chance (7 of 21); fitted from its boxes, 21 of 21. Needs TYPESAFEAI_API_KEY.

06 / AGENT SKILL

Install once.
Ask naturally.

Add vlmkit once—there are no skill names to learn. Describe the outcome, and the AI classifies the request and artifacts, loads the right workflow, and runs it until the checks pass.

vlmkit
